import hashlib,json,statistics,subprocess,zipfile
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();perf=root/'docs/performance'
def load(p):return json.loads(p.read_text())
def ref(row):
 p=root/row['path'];b=p.read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==row['sha256'] and len(b)==row['bytes'];return p
main=load(perf/'chatgpt-animation-computed-scan-production-20261105.json');assert main['complete'] and main['implementation_disposition']=='reverted'and main['rollback_commit']=='cf8124f26'
assert main['page_instruction_credit']==main['broad_cadence_after']==0 and not main['broad_required'] and not main['acceptance']
assert main['guard']['child_exit_code']==main['archive_guard']['child_exit_code']==0 and main['guard']['adoption_error']is None
for key in ['controller','diagnostic','matched','focused_component','previous_rejected_cohort']:ref(main[key])
controller=load(root/main['controller']['path']);assert controller['status']=='complete'and controller['production_before']==controller['production_after']==main['production']
for key,count in [('diagnostic',4),('matched',8)]:
 d=load(root/main[key]['path']);assert d['complete']and d['identity_stable']and d['inputs_before']==d['inputs_after']and len(d['observations'])==count
 assert all(r['content_exact']and r['pixels_exact']and r['exit']==r['kernel_exit_status']==0 for r in d['observations'])
controls=main['control'];candidates=main['candidate'];assert statistics.median(r['upper']for r in controls)==main['control_median'];assert statistics.median(r['upper']for r in candidates)==main['candidate_median']
assert min(r['lower']for r in controls)-max(r['upper']for r in candidates)==main['conservative_page_instruction_reduction']
assert min(r['lower']for r in candidates)>max(r['upper']for r in controls)
previous=load(root/main['previous_rejected_cohort']['path']);assert not previous['complete']and previous['status']=='rejected'and previous['guard']['child_exit_code']==1 and previous['page_instruction_credit']==0
focus=load(ref(main['focused_component']));assert focus['focused']['passed']and focus['focused_test_function_executions']==416
rollback=load(ref(main['rollback']['chatgpt-animation-computed-scan-rollback-20261105.json']));assert rollback['complete']and rollback['checks']['passed']and rollback['test_function_executions']==188
restored=load(ref(main['rollback']['chatgpt-animation-computed-scan-rollback-production-20261105.json']));assert restored['complete']and restored['identity_stable']and len(restored['observations'])==2
assert all(r['content_exact']and r['pixels_exact']and r['exit']==r['kernel_exit_status']==0 for r in restored['observations']);assert restored['guard']['child_exit_code']==0
for name,value in rollback['restored_source_sha256'].items():
 assert hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==value
 assert(root/name).read_bytes()==subprocess.check_output(['git','show','2e547acea^:'+name])
assert not(root/'css/animation_sample_computed_scan_test.v').exists()and not(root/'tools/animation_sample_computed_scan_benchmark.v').exists()
archives={r['path']:r for r in [*main['evidence'],rollback['evidence'],restored['evidence']]};blobs=0
for row in archives.values():
 p=ref(row)
 with zipfile.ZipFile(p)as z:
  assert z.testzip()is None
  for n in z.namelist():
   if n.startswith('blobs/'):assert hashlib.sha256(z.read(n)).hexdigest()==n[6:];blobs+=1
  for r in json.loads(z.read('index.json'))['entries'].values():assert len(z.read('blobs/'+r['sha256']))==r['bytes']
print(json.dumps(dict(archives=len(archives),blobs=blobs,all_attempts=18,successful_content_pixel_captures=17,rejected_ownership_launches=1,prototype_test_executions=416,rollback_test_executions=188,statistics_recomputed=True,restored_source_exact=True,page_instruction_credit=0)))
